BiblicalUsage: zâqân means the beard (as indicating age). In Leviticus 13:29 we read, "If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;". It appears again in 1 Samuel 17:35: "And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me..."
TheologicalSignificance: zaqan is the beard (as indicating age), and I believe God does not use words carelessly, so this one does the work he gave it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
